_comment: Peacock pack switches read by kubejs/server_scripts/*.js. Server-side; takes effect on /reload or restart. ladder=false disables recipe staging and place/hire gates (Blueprints still drop). sleepPercent: players (%) that must sleep to skip the night (-1 = vanilla rule untouched). bossBarScale: size of boss bars on screen, client-side (1 = vanilla). tabListOffset: GUI pixels the player list (Tab) is moved down so it opens below the compass bar, client-side (0 = vanilla position).
